scope: Proposition 4.4 (Specified homotopy) of the manuscript “Boundary graph deformations for the spacetime Penrose inequality” (preprints/Boundary-graph-deformations-for-the-spacetime-Penrose-inequality-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a continuous piecewise smooth family of systems indexed by s ∈ [0, 4], beginning at (4.7), (4.18) and the original Dirichlet values, and ending at f = 0 and the scalar problem with zero source and zero inner conormal flux. Throughout its first three stages the source is (4.17), with T evaluated using the actual trace F. Each trace equation has right-side derivative at least one in h, with x, Z, ∇f fixed.
